Really smart idea to have a Maxi right in the heart of downtown. For students and many others who don’t have cars or rely only on public transportation, this kind of store is much needed.

The store looks clean and well organized as it should, being brand new, and I hope it stays that way. I didn’t have the time to explore every aisle, but from what I saw they seem to carry most of the essentials. The location is excellent.

The only downside is for people with cars: parking is limited and only available on the street with parking meters (not provided by Maxi).

I just shopped at this maxi, and for the first I bought more stuff than usual as I normally go to Provigo, Adonis or Iga. I had the most rude expérience at the Cashier . I called the client service but could not talk to a manager so I am leaving my expérience here. Amongst my things was an article that belonged to the customer in front of me . So I let the Cashier know before she scans it . She does not thank me , she just talks to the other customer to say that she will scan it after my stuff . Then comes the payment , I am still trying to put the things I bought in my bag in the little space the customer in front of me left , she said , you can pay , I reply : Yes when I have finished packing my things. She apparently finds it weird and says nothing . 30 seconds later , I pay but I am still putting my things in the bag, and I am in front the card reader . She turns right to the other customer and asks him to pay . So basically asks him to come right next behind me 5 cm away while I am still here packing my grocery . I ask her if she can wait till I finish packing , she replies ' what is your problem ' while she requests from the customer to come right next to me . Here is my problem : 1. I do not expect to be treated as a cattle at the cashier  2. Having one personal space while shopping is a very légitimate request , at least , in a civilised place 3 . I will not accept verbal abuse from a maxi employée in front of other customers because another client did not check that his grocery have been all counted ! last but not least , I do not have to be stressed to pack quickly my groceries when I pay ... Horrible expérience . I will go back to shopping to other places where client is respected . The Employée I dealt with should learn how to behave, especially with people twice her age. You lost a Client .

I’m very disappointed. Many of the fruits and vegetables are rotten and not being removed from the shelves. Groceries are already very expensive these days, so customers deserve better quality and care. The store should do a better job ensuring freshness and proper rotation of produce.

Finally, something useful for the public has been done and realized. This is a crowded city, and it was necessary to open such market branches in the city center. For example, IKEA could open a smaller-scale location in the downtown area — there’s a huge need for it. In Toronto, they had it. More services that make people’s lives easier should be provided. The city needs to keep up with the modern world and offer cleaner, higher-quality places. People living here shouldn’t have to be stuck with filthy, smelly environments.

The new downtown Maxi is clean, well-stocked, and offers good prices. It has a nice variety of products, including ethnic items, which are increasingly common in Maxi stores and are much appreciated.

That said, the space is small—as is typical in a downtown location—and during peak hours, like Sunday evenings, it can get crowded. The number of checkouts is also limited, which can lengthen the wait.

In short, a good option for quick purchases or for shopping during quieter times.
